svg.style: transform: none; transform-origin: 8px 8px; opacity: 1; filter: none; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-dashoffset: 0px; mix-blend-mode: normal; animation: auto ease 0s 1 normal none running none; transition: none; position: static;

path.style: transform: none; transform-origin: 0px 0px; opacity: 1; filter: none; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: rgb(46, 32, 20); stroke-width: 2.6px; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-dashoffset: 0px; mix-blend-mode: normal; animation: auto ease 0s 1 normal none running none; transition: none;
